name: Scadrial
summary: Birthplace of allomancy, feruchemy, and hemallurgy. A planet marked by ash, mists, and revolution.

investiture.name: Allomancy
investiture.summary: Burning metals ingested to grant physical or mental powers. Sixteen base metals.

investiture.name: Feruchemy
investiture.summary: Storing attributes like strength, speed, or memory in metal minds for later use.

investiture.name: Hemalurgy
investiture.summary: Stealing attributes from others via metal spikes driven through the body.
